bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the Somali Museum of Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SOMALI MUSEUM OF MINNESOTA.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Somali Museum of Minnesota to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new facility in the city of Minneapolis to preserve Somali cultural heritage, display Somali relics and artifacts, and offer educational programs. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
additions: $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Somali Museum of Minnesota to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new facility in the city of Minneapolis to preserve Somali cultural heritage, display Somali relics and artifacts, and offer educational programs. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
